secCriticalReset.title: Force Password Reset for Critical Risk Identities
secCriticalReset.description: {count} identities have critical risk scores and require immediate password reset.
secCriticalReset.action: Force immediate password reset and enable MFA for all critical risk users. Per ISO 27001:2022 (Control A.5.17) and Chile Law 21.719 (Art. 14 - Security Measures).

secAdminAudit.title: Audit Administrator Account Access
secAdminAudit.description: {count} administrator accounts have been found in data breaches.
secAdminAudit.action: Review and rotate credentials for all exposed administrator accounts. Consider implementing just-in-time access. Per ISO 27001:2022 (Control A.8.2) and ISO 27002:2022 (Control 5.15).

secMfaDeployment.title: Enable Multi-Factor Authentication
secMfaDeployment.description: {count} high-risk identities should have MFA enabled immediately.
secMfaDeployment.action: Deploy MFA for all high-risk users and monitor for suspicious activity. Required by ISO 27001:2022 (Control A.8.5 - Secure Authentication).

secFinanceAudit.title: Review Finance Team Access
secFinanceAudit.description: {count} finance team members have breach exposure.
secFinanceAudit.action: Audit access to financial systems and rotate credentials for exposed accounts. Per ISO 27002:2022 (Control 5.18 - Access Rights).

secMonitorRecent.title: Monitor Recently Exposed Accounts
secMonitorRecent.description: {count} identities appear in breaches from the last 90 days.
secMonitorRecent.action: Implement enhanced monitoring for recently exposed accounts. Check for signs of compromise. Per ISO 27001:2022 (Control A.8.16) and Chile Law 21.719 (Art. 14 bis - Breach Notification).

legalBreachAssessment.title: Assess Recent Breach Impact
legalBreachAssessment.description: {count} identities appear in breaches from the last 90 days.
legalBreachAssessment.action: Conduct impact assessment and determine notification requirements per Chile Data Protection Law 21.719 (Art. 14 bis and Art. 14 ter - Notification Obligations).

legalDocumentation.title: Document Incident Response Actions
legalDocumentation.description: Maintain audit trail of all remediation actions taken for {count} exposed identities.
legalDocumentation.action: Document all password resets, MFA deployments, and user notifications. Retain evidence for compliance per ISO 27001:2022 (Control A.5.24) and Chile Law 21.719 (Art. 11 - Activity Records).

legalRegulatoryReview.title: Review Regulatory Obligations
legalRegulatoryReview.description: With {percent}% exposure rate, review applicable data protection regulations.
legalRegulatoryReview.action: Assess Chile Data Protection Law 21.719 requirements for breach notification (Art. 14 bis - 72-hour deadline to notify the Data Protection Agency).

legalVendorNotification.title: Notify Affected Business Partners
legalVendorNotification.description: Critical exposure may require notification to business partners and vendors.
legalVendorNotification.action: Review contracts and determine if breach notification to partners is required per Chile Law 21.719 (Art. 14 quater - Data Processor Responsibilities).

execRiskSummary.title: Executive Risk Summary
execRiskSummary.description: {percent}% of monitored identities have breach exposure. {criticalCount} require immediate attention.
execRiskSummary.action: Review security posture and approve emergency remediation budget if needed. Non-compliance with ISO 27001:2022 and Chile Law 21.719 may result in fines up to 10,000 UTM.

execBudgetReview.title: Security Investment Review
execBudgetReview.description: Current exposure levels suggest need for enhanced security controls.
execBudgetReview.action: Review and approve budget for additional security tools and training. ISO 27001:2022 (Control A.5.2) requires adequate resource allocation for information security.

execTraining.title: Security Awareness Training
execTraining.description: Schedule security training focusing on password hygiene and phishing awareness.
execTraining.action: Approve and schedule organization-wide security awareness training. Required by ISO 27002:2022 (Control 6.3 - Information Security Awareness).

execPolicyUpdate.title: Update Security Policies
execPolicyUpdate.description: Review and update password and access management policies.
execPolicyUpdate.action: Approve updated security policies addressing credential management and breach response. Per ISO 27001:2022 (Control A.5.1) and ISO 27002:2022 (Control 5.1 - Security Policies).
